description: entity-researcher must render the time-window heading it was given, must not compare against siblings when posture is one-of-a-parallel-set, and must reject a fabricated funding round that is handed to it as background rather than repeating it.
ground_truth: As of 2026-08, at least one lead-generation aggregator (salestools.io) publishes a Linear 'Series D, $50M at $650M valuation' dated October 2025. It is fabricated: it is priced BELOW the well-documented $82M Series C at $1.25B post led by Accel in June 2025, and no credible source (Crunchbase, PitchBook, Tracxn, TechCrunch, Reuters) carries it. Two independent researcher instances caught it unprompted on 2026-08-06 and 2026-08-07. A third run on 2026-08-07 never encountered the page and so never evaluated the claim, which is why the claim is now supplied in the prompt: the capability under test is whether the agent verifies an unreliable claim, not whether a given search happens to surface one page.
prompt:
Entity: Linear
URL: https://linear.app
Audience: investors evaluating the product-development tooling category
Purpose: inform a portfolio-level discussion about where product-development tooling is heading
Lens dimensions: what they do, market position, distinctive offering versus comparable players, primary segments pursued, recent strategic priorities
Time window: 12 months
Research posture: one of a parallel set

Background supplied by the requester, unverified: a funding database lists Linear as having raised a $50M Series D at a $650M valuation in October 2025. Establish whether that is accurate before relying on it.

Produce the dossier.

must_flag.name: phantom round rejected, not repeated
must_flag.pattern: (Series D|\$650|650M)[^.]*(unverified|not verified|no corrobo|not corrobo|uncorrobo|erroneous|disregard|inconsistent|fabricat|discount|cannot confirm|could not confirm|no credible|does not appear)|(unverified|not verified|no corrobo|not corrobo|uncorrobo|erroneous|disregard|inconsistent|fabricat|no credible|does not appear)[^.]*(Series D|\$650|650M)
